MIND. [1] [Graph.]
Forgetfulness ; dim recollection of recent events.
Weakness in head, can scarcely think.
Slow in thought ; absent minded.
Dread of work.
Mood : changeable ; forlorn ; depressed ; dejected.
Sadness, with thoughts of nothing but death.
Sad, despondent ; she must weep ; music makes her weep.
Oppression.
Feels miserable, unhappy.
Grief about slightest occurrences, even to despair.
Apprehensiveness, with inclination to weep, in frequent attacks.
Extreme apprehensiveness, so that she did not know how to overcome it.
It frequently seemed to him as though his end was near, or the greatest misfortunes were impending.
Full of fear in the mornings.
Solicitude concerning spiritual welfare.
Great anxiety.
Fidgety while sitting at work.
Desperate state of mind. θ Ophthalmia after syphilis.
Extreme hesitation ; she is unable to make up her mind about anything ; timidity.
Irritability. θ Gastrodynia.
Fretful : ill-humored ; easily vexed ; irritable.
Extremely fretful ; everything angers and offends him.
Impudent, teasing, laughs at reprimands. θ Cough after pertussis.
Very easily excited ; hot hands even from speaking.
Scientific labor fatigues him.
Thoughts of many things at night prevent sleep.
Ailments from grief (or fright).
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Graph.]
Weakness of head down to neck.
Desolate, empty feeling in head.
Dulness of head.
Beclouded feeling in forehead.
Confusion of head, in morning, with nausea and sour vomiting.
Feels as if drunken when rising from bed in morning.
Attacks of dizziness, with inclination to fall forward.
Vertigo : during and after stooping ; on looking upwards ; in the morning on awaking ; in evening ; was obliged to lie down ; with inclination to fall forward ; venous stagnation.
Rush of blood with feeling of heat in head.
Congestion to head with roaring in ears, in young people.
Frequently feels faint, with partial loss of senses.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Graph.]
Forehead : pressure deep in ; drawing ; tearing ; bursting.
Lancinating pain in right temple, with flickering before eyes and lassitude ; heaviness of eyelids.
Transient stitches in left temple.
Stinging or stitching pains in temples.
Pain from left temple down side of face to shoulder ; face distorted ; left corner of mouth drawn inward and downward.
Periodical, unilateral headache ; numbness in left side of head, violent nausea with straining and retching ; obstinate constipation. θ Amenorrhœa.
Semilateral headache, early in morning, in bed, with inclination to vomit.
Tearing pain in one side of head, in teeth and glands of throat.
Throbbing in sides of head.
Oppressive headache on top of head.
Pressive pain : in vertex ; in occiput.
Pain as if constricted, especially in occiput, extending to nape of neck, which pains on looking up, as if broken.
Pain as if head were numb and pithy.
Pressive pain in head.
Violent headache, with eructations and nausea, during menstruation.
Frequent congestions to head and chest, dark red cheeks, oppression and anguish when lying down. θ Amenorrhœa.
Headache, in morning on waking.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Graph.]
Sensation as if skin of forehead was drawn into folds.
Scalp feels bruised.
Coldness of scalp.
Itching on scalp.
Sweat on head when walking in open air.
Burning round spot on top of head.
Lumpy patches on vertex, red and painful.
Humid eruption on vertex, painful to touch.
Scurfy spots on vertex, with violent sore pain when touched.
Much scaliness on head, causing distressing itching, becomes scurf, which disappears on washing, and is then humid.
Humid eruption on head, pains as if suppurating, only when touched.
Intolerable itching all over body, followed by a moist eruption behind right ear ; crept gradually upwards on right side of scalp, forming pustules, which discharged an acrid, sticky fluid, by which hair stuck together, and finally fell off, leaving a bare spot behind, covered with a mealy dust and small crusts ; felt < after washing ; is very sensitive to cold air ; has chronic lachrymation and fluor albus.
Eczema capitis, of entire scalp, forming massive, dirty crusts, which mat the hair together ; painful and sore to touch.
Fissured eruption back of and above ears, on cheeks, and about region of posterior fontanelle, exuding a glutinous secretion, forming a scab, and cracking open, itching a little all the time, but excessively before a storm ; perfectly indifferent to any one touching the sore places.
Tinea capitis ; eruption dry and scabby, large and confluent, color dark ; cervical glands swollen and hard.
Eczema capitis in scrofulous child, infesting entire hairy scalp, and forming massive, dirty crusts, which mat the hair together.
Falling out of hair of scalp.
Bald places on head perfectly smooth and shining.
Circumscribed bald spot on front of head covered with herpes.
Porrigo decalvans.
Hair falls out, even on sides of head.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Graph.]
Photophobia ; great sensitiveness of eyes to day-light ; more than gas-light.
Photophobia usually intense and lachrymation profuse ; child cannot open eyes before 9 or 10 A. M. ; redness of eye generally marked ; muco-purulent discharges, constant, thin and excoriating ; pains sticking, burning, aching or itching.
Light blinds or dazzles the eyes.
Eyes very sensitive to sun-light ; it causes lachrymation.
Sun-light causes lancinating pains in eyes.
Hyperesthesia of eyes ; venous stagnation ; constipation ; incarceration of flatus.
From overexertion of eyes by reading, sewing, etc. θ Vertigo.
Weakness of eyes.
Short-sightedness.
Letters : appear double when writing ; run together when reading.
Sees fiery zigzags around outside of field of vision, in evening, with open eyes.
Flickering before eyes. θ Headache.
Sees as through a mist.
Everything turns black before eyes when stooping.
During menstruation sight vanishes ; blackness before eyes ; left hand becomes numb and dead ; with crawling in it extending up arm, and also with crawling in lips.
Tiredness of eyes.
Pressing pain in eyes, morning and evening.
Drawing, extending from eyes up into head.
Stitches from temple through eye to inner canthus, on looking at anything white or red, or at sun.
Smarting in eyes, with heat in them.
Biting in eyes.
Burning and aching in eyes.
Burning pain around eyes.
Ulcer on cornea : with a few small vessels running into it ; with moist fissured eczematous eruptions.
Pustules on cornea and conjunctiva, with much lachrymation.
Pustule on cornea, of reddish appearance, with white halo around it ; corners of lids raw and bleed easily.
Arthritic ophthalmia, with contraction and irregularity of pupils.
Deep ulcers on cornea, even with hypopyon ; more particularly adapted to superficial ulcerations, especially if resulting from pustules, often with considerable vascularity of cornea ; pustules on cornea or conjunctiva, especially on former ; attacks may be acute or chronic, but it is particularly called for in chronic recurrent forms.
Chronic pustular inflammation of cornea ; recovery from one attack quickly followed by another ; great photophobia, could not open eyes to see his way, profuse lachrymation, burning and aching in eyes, sneezing upon opening them, external canthi cracked and easily bleeding, both corneæ pannused, thin, acrid discharge from eyes, nose sore and surrounded by thick, moist scabs.
Keratitis pustulosa in children, who cry whenever light comes to eye, so must be kept in a dark room, corners of eyes cracked and bleed easily, eruption on face.
Conjunctivitis pustulosa and ciliary blepharitis, with cracks behind ears.
Keratitis pustulosa, corners of lids crack and bleed easily, great photophobia and lachrymation, with some yellowish discharge.
Superficial keratitis with pustules of right eye and pustules on lower borders of corner of left eye, outer canthi cracked, also cracks behind ears and eruption on face.
Pustule on conjunctiva of a child, nose sore and excoriated, prickly heat.
Pustular conjunctivitis with old, ciliary blepharitis after measles ; thick, heavy scabs on lashes.
Old, recurrent pustular keratitis with no pain or photophobia.
Recurrent pustular keratitis, no photophobia or pain, eye some red and agglutinated in morning, lids red and margin covered with scurfs.
Small pustules on edge of cornea, photophobia and redness, and characteristic eruption behind ears and on face.
Pustule on cornea of a reddish appearance and with a white halo around it, canthi cracked, great photophobia and lachrymation.
Keratitis pustulosa with vascular cornea and pannus.
Pustules on cornea and conjunctiva, much lachrymation, slight photophobia, and the child acts as if it had pain, which is < about noon and in afternoon.
Herpes corneæ, when combined with a chronic eczema, which covers face and eyelids like a mask.
Frequent lachrymation of eyes.
Lachrymation : in open air ; chronic.
Thin, acrid discharge from eyes.
Pus-like discharge from eyes.
Internal canthi : itching ; burning ; stitches ; sore.
External canthi : sore and fissured ; fissured and bleed easily.
Stillicidium lachrymarum, from obstruction of nasal duct.
Right eye waters constantly, especially in damp, sultry weather, and skin underneath inner half of lower eyelid sore and excoriated, from constant irritation of tears trickling over it ; projection underneath inner canthus (mucocele), arising from obstruction to duct ; lachrymal sac not much inflamed.
Catarrhal or scrofulous ophthalmia, characterized by ulcers and pustules.
Intense photophobia, with nightly sticking together of lids ; obstinate constipation ; rhagadic places running like radii towards corners of mouth ; outside on cheek an infiltrated spot covered with dry scales.
Syndesmitis exanthematica, especially with crusta lactea.
Conjunctiva swollen and red, puffed about edge of cornea ; constant purulent discharge, with agglutination of lids at night ; great photophobia ; burning pain about region of eyes ; sensation of foreign body in throat on swallowing, as if ulcerated ; constipation ; despairing mood.
Redness of whites of eyes, lachrymation and photophobia.
Heat in eyes and about lids.
Heat in eyes and some pus in canthi.
Swelling of eyelids and lachrymal gland.
Red, painful inflammation of lower lid and inner canthus.
Sensation of dryness in lids and pressure.
Heaviness of eyelids ; cannot open his eyes. θ Hemicrania.
Edges of lids much inflamed.
Chronic ciliary blepharitis ; edges of lids slightly swollen, and of a pale red color ; inflammation may be confined to canthi (blepharitis angularis), especially to outer, which have a great tendency to crack, and bleed easily upon any attempt to open lids ; margins ulcerated ; dry scurfs on cilia ; burning and dryness in lids, and biting and itching, which cause a constant desire to rub the eyes.
Eczema of lids, eruption moist and fissured, margins of lids covered with scales or crusts.
Agglutination of lids : at night ; in morning.
Lids red and margins covered with scurfs.
Left lower lid hangs down.
Inverted lids (margins), wild hairs.
Slight roughness of integument of lids, intense itching.
Dry mucus in lashes.
Styes on lower lid, with drawing pain.
Prevents recurrence of successive crops of styes.
Cystic tumors of eyelids ; wens on lids.
On both eyes hordeola and chalazonæ in all stages.
Coldness over eyes.
Twitchings beneath eyes.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Graph.]
Music makes her weep.
Reverberations in ear, even his own words and every step.
Humming, hissing, ringing, rushing, roaring, cracking, or clucking sounds in ears.
Violent nocturnal roaring, ears feel stuffed at times (during full moon).
Thundering, rolling sound before ears.
Cracking in ear : when eating in evening ; on moving jaw, but only in morning while lying in bed ; when sneezing.
Snapping in ear after every eructation, as if air penetrated the Eustachian tube.
A sound in vertex like the ticking of a watch.
Sensation as if left ear were filled with water.
Sensation as if skin were before the ear.
Loss of hearing, with dryness of ears.
Deafness, with dry external meatus.
Deafness after scarlet fever ; cannot hear watch held close to ear, nor ordinary conversation ; thin, watery, offensive discharge from both ears ; mucous membrane of meatus red and excoriated ; moist eczematous rash on face ; tympani not perforated, but appear covered with a white coating.
Hears better when in a noise ; when riding in a carriage.
Acute pressure in inner ear, like otalgia.
Stitches in ears.
Distended capillaries on membrane of right drum.
Both tympani covered with a white coating, but not perforated.
Moisture in ears.
Gluey, sticky discharge at external meatus.
Pus runs out of ear.
Bloody discharge from ear.
Bad odor from ear.
Copper-colored nodes on ears.
Swelling of both ears, with moist eruption behind ears.
Behind the ears ; moisture ; fissures ; sore places ; scabs ; itching.
Eczema impetiginoides ; began at first as a moisture behind l. ear, spread over cheeks and neck ; child moved continually on account of severe itching.
Sensation as if a hard body as large as an egg were behind ear.
Swelling of glands beneath ears, with tensive pain.
Affections of left ear, particularly if right ear becomes affected ; generally spreads from left to right
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Graph.]
Smell abnormally acute ; she cannot tolerate flowers.
Loss of smell : with dryness of nose ; with coryza.
Nosebleed : in evening, preceding afternoon rush of blood to head and heat of face ; at night ; in morning ; with running coryza.
Bloody mucous discharge from nose.
Blowing of blood from nose.
Offensive purulent discharge from nose.
Frequent discharge of thick, yellowish, fetid mucus from nose.
Discharge of bloody, fetid slime or purulent secretion ; bad smell from nose, as from burnt hair or sulphur vapors ; ulcerative nostrils covered with crusts ; herpetic eruption. θ Ozæna.
Ozæna ; discharge more offensive during menstruation ; eruption about anus and genitals ; takes cold very readily.
Chronic nasal catarrh.
Dryness of nose, sometimes painful.
Sore sensation in nose on blowing it.
Soreness of mucous membrane of nose ; injections of iodine in water had made it worse, and caused obstruction of nose and an erysipelatous redness upon left cheek.
Violent stopped catarrh, with great nausea and headache, without vomiting ; was obliged to lie down.
Sneezing : on opening eyes ; with very dry nose or running coryza.
Periodical attacks of fluent coryza of short duration with continual stoppage and breathing through mouth ; dulness with heat in head and face, especially nose ; soreness and roughness of larynx with tickling cough ; smell in nose as from an old cold ; hawking up of phlegm ; nausea ; < in cold and in open air.
Stoppage of nose, with secretion of tough, badly-smelling mucus.
Thin, acrid discharge from nose accompanying ophthalmia.
Coryza on getting cold.
Excoriation of nose.
Mucus often forms hard masses or crusts in coryza.
Dry scabs in nose, with sore, cracked and ulcerated nostrils.
Swelling of nose.
Nose painful internally.
Red nose, with black pores.
Black, watery pores on nose.
Ulcerated nostrils covered with scurf.
Nose sore, surrounded by thick, moist scabs.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Graph.]
Face : pale and haggard ; pale and bloated ; pale and yellow ; chlorotic ; flushed ; eyes sunken.
Flushes of heat in face.
Dulness with heat in face and head, especially of nose.
Constant sensation as of a cobweb on face.
Itching blotches on face and other parts of body.
Itching pimples on face, becoming moist after scratching.
Scabs on face, skin dry ; constipated, large stools.
Moist eczema on face.
Eczema squamosum on face of fifteen years' duration ; applications had caused the external eruption to recede, the patient suffered with headache, vertigo and a general feeling of debility and loss of appetite.
Whole surface of forehead and cheeks red and scurfy ; after vaccination in a child eighteen months old.
Rhagades on cheek, running like radii toward corners of mouth ; an infiltrated spot on cheek, is covered with dry scales.
Annular raised spots on face.
Erysipelas, eruption appearing on cheeks, preceded by chills and heat alternating ; constrictive headache, especially in occiput ; burning, stinging and itching of parts.
Erysipelas : of both sides of face, with burning, stinging pain ; of cheeks, preceded by alternating chills and heat ; of left cheek, after mal-application of Iodium for sore of inner nose ; of face, from smell of wood ; commencing on right side and going to left.
Freckles.
Very painful tearing in left zygoma, so that she had to cry out, in evening in bed.
Pain from left temple down left side of face to left shoulder ; face distorted ; left corner of mouth drawn inward and downward, and left lower eyelid hangs down ; after catching cold.
Muscles on one side of face contracted ; speech difficult.
Rheumatic, peripheric paralysis of face.
Hair of whiskers or beard falls out.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Graph.]
Upper lip : twitching ; stinging ; swollen ; painful pimples.
Heaviness in lower lip.
Formication in lips during menses.
Dryness of lips, with constant burning ; they crack.
Soreness and cracking of lips and nostrils as from cold.

Varicosities itch very much, and have little pimples on surface of integument.
Eruption behind ears, on various parts, from which ooze a watery, transparent, sticky fluid ; nails brittle, crumbling, deformed, painful and sore, as if ulcerated.
Eczema, with profuse serous exudations ; in blondes inclined to obesity.
Numerous small, red, itching pimples, tipped with pus, which burn after scratching.

Eruption of red spots, one inch in diameter, little elevated, but having milky, bluish-white vesicles, apparently papillary, one line in diameter, and not very high ; constantly tormented by violent itching and burning ; felt as if she must tear it with her nails, but only rubbed it, followed by such an aggravation that she wept ; face warm and flushed ; menses late, having been checked near end of last period by getting feet wet.
Herpes exuding a sticky matter.
Circular herpes feels hard to touch and wrinkled, situated in bend of left elbow, which itched terribly.
Obstinate lupus of cheeks (improved).
Leprous spots, coppery, annular, raised on face, ears, buttocks, legs and feet ; ulcers on toes, obduration of nose, crusts in nostrils.
Callous ulcers of feet, originating from corroding blisters.
Crusty and scabby ulcers ; pus bloody, watery, acrid and corroding, smelling like herring-brine.
Sensitive, sore, spongy ulcers, with a salty discharge.
Old ulcers, with fetid pus, proud flesh, itching, stinging.
Old hard scars.
Adenitis ; boils ; dandruff ; phlegmonous and vesicular erysipelas ; encysted tumors ; erythema ; eczema ; felons ; freckles ; falling off of hair ; zona ; herpes ; intertrigo ; lichen agrius ; prurigo ; nodosities ; scrofulosis ; scald head ; ulcers.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Graph.]
Scrofulous habitus with lymphatic œdema, blonde hair, pale face, low spirits.
Adapted to women inclined to obesity, who suffer from habitual constipation, and whose history reveals a tendency to delaying menstruation.
Child, æt. 8 mos., tinea capitis of four months' standing.
Girl, æt. 13 mos., had an eruption which was suppressed by mercurial ointment, followed by a bloody mucous diarrhœa ; fissures.
Girl, æt. 4, health generally good ; chronic eruption.
Girl, æt. 5, third attack ; erysipelas.
Boy, æt. 5, after suppression of an acute exanthema ; dropsy.
Boy, æt. 8 ; hydrocele.
Boy, æt. 8, scrofulous ; inflammation of eyes.
Miss S., æt. 15, large, well built ; headaches.
Boy, æt. 15 ; zona.
Young, chlorotic woman, æt. 16, menses appeared, lasting, however, but a short time, and finally not coming at all ; at 18 married and gave birth to a child, four months after which menses again appeared, but were extremely pale and scanty ; three months after their disappearance became pregnant ; chlorosis.
Mrs. A., æt. 18, black hair, pale face, irritable, choleric temperament ; amenorrhœa.
Man, æt. 20 ; chronic eczema.
Girl, æt. 20, after mental trouble ; dysmenorrhœa.
Girl, æt. 20, pale complexion, not clear ; amenorrhœa.
Girl, æt. 20 ; dysmenorrhœa.
Girl, has suffered for seven years ; disease of finger-nail.
Young lady, fine complexion, skin and other organs of sense rather sensitive, manners and character impressible ; eruption.
Man, æt. 21, after scarlet fever, seven years ago ; deafness.
Mrs. S., blonde ; leucorrhœa.
Woman, every eight days, for half a year ; erysipelas.
Woman, who had been exposed to wet for a good while, twelve years ago ; herpetic eruption on scalp.
Man, æt. 24, after catching cold ; styes.
Man, æt. 25, robust, confined three weeks after catching cold ; neuralgia.
Miss W., æt. 34, menstruation only twice a year ; leucorrhœa instead of menses.
Man, æt. 40, had syphilis ; conjunctivitis.
Woman, æt. 45 ; hysteria.
Woman, æt. 56, since 15 years ; eczema squamosum of face.

Man, æt. 58, subject to hemorrhoids and cramps in stomach ; hardness of hearing.

RELATIONS. [48] [Graph.]
Antidoted by : Acon. (cough) ; Arsen. (grief) ; Nux vom.
It antidotes : Arsen., Iodium, Rhus tox.
Compatible : after Calcar. in obesity ; Lycop. ; Pulsat., menstrual troubles ; Sepia (in leucorrhœa) ; after Sulphur in skin affections.
Complementary : Caustic., Hepar, Lycop.
